variant: sheathing cell R2 to R5 (2 to 5 robots)
name: Randek ZeroLabor sheathing cell
summary: Robot cell with two to five six-axis industrial robots on rails that lay OSB, gypsum and other boards on timber or light-gauge-steel wall frames, staple, screw or nail them and mill the openings, in one or several layers, straight from CAD data. Randek's most proven ZeroLabor cell, sold since 2017.

germany.statusNote: Sold on request by Randek (Falkenberg, Sweden) after a pre-study; Randek lists a German branch and names Wolfgang Horn of Horn Hausbau Technologie as its representative for Germany, Austria and Switzerland. No price published.
germany.leadTime: Set per project in a pre-study (maker)

notes: arms is capped at 4 by the schema; the cell has 2 (R2) to 5 (R5) robots.
Robots change between vacuum sheet grippers, milling, fastening and recycling tools on their own via a tool changer.
Can run inside a Randek AutoWall line, inside an existing line of another make, or stand-alone (maker).
Robot payload and reach are set per project and not published.
